name: Theodor Berggren
event: UFC Fight Night: Moicano vs. Nolan
summary: A 27-year-old Swedish southpaw (8-4) from Fight Club Rush and Cage Warriors who has never won a decision: all eight wins are stoppages, six in R1. Took his UFC debut on about three weeks' notice in Baku and was stopped in R2 by Daniil Donchenko.

how_they_fight.Striking: Aggressive, forward striker who wants to win with strength, range and output (UFC.com). ClutchPoints' preview credits him with good timing, head/body/leg kicks and fast pressure. Against Donchenko he landed a step-in knee and a clean left hand but was out-landed 23-71 and hurt by a right hook in R1 (Sherdog play-by-play).
how_they_fight.Grappling: Three R1 submission wins on the regional scene (rear-naked chokes per MMA UK). Barely grappled in Baku (no takedown attempts). Tapped to an arm-triangle in R3 against Justin Burlinson at Cage Warriors 181.
how_they_fight.Defense: Leaky in his debut: kept a high guard but ate leg kicks and body shots, then a right head kick through the guard dropped him and two hooks finished it (Sherdog via Yahoo). Absorbed 5.4 significant strikes a minute on our small UFC sample.
how_they_fight.Pace & cardio: Fast starter whose results get worse the longer fights go. Finishes: R1 6, R2 1 (Battaglia, 4:44), R3 1 (Samedov TKO). Losses: two 15-minute decisions (Christian Stigenberg 2022, Leonardo Damiani 2025), an R3 submission (Burlinson, 2:44) and the R2 TKO to Donchenko (1:35). So three of his four losses came late or on the cards, and he is 0-2 in fights that reached the judges. Durability: stopped once by strikes (head kick plus punches), once by submission.
how_they_fight.Fight IQ: Confident and aggressive, says he has a 100% finish rate and expects a war (UFC.com). The short-notice debut against a rising TUF winner was a big step; his more recent two regional wins came later in fights (R2, R3), which ClutchPoints credited to better preparation.

patterns: Every win is a finish; six of eight in R1
Never won a decision (0-2 on the cards)
Late losses: R3 submission, two decisions, and an R2 TKO in his UFC debut
concerns: Defense against kicks and body work; dropped twice in his debut
Grappling defense late in fights (arm-triangle loss in R3)
Big jump in competition: 1-1 in Cage Warriors before the UFC call
keys_to_beat: Weather his early burst, then take over in R2 and R3
Chop the lead leg and body (Donchenko's blueprint)
Wrestle him late; he has been submitted in R3 and lost both fights that went the distance

news.text: Booked against Rodrigo Sezinando at welterweight for Oct. 31 (Heavy).
UFC debut on short notice (replacing Andreas Gustafsson, who withdrew with a medical issue): lost to Daniil Donchenko by R2 TKO (head kick and punches, 1:35).
Sources disagree on his last regional fight: ClutchPoints (via Yahoo) listed a TKO loss to Abdulatip Samedov, while our verified data records an R3 TKO win over Samedov at FCR 27 (Feb. 2026).
